name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-live-containers
description: The live-containers hook: an EffectTS DeepSeek Harness plugin (the Classic twin behind Effect v4) that keeps dynamic, modifiable conversation blocks in the system prompt. Each enabled block is a labeled stanza recomputed at every request - the canonical example is a time block that always holds the current time at ask-time while the rest of the conversation stays static. The blocks ride the system-prompt/assemble waterfall as ONE appended section named live-containers (interpolate: false, so only the plugin's own substitution engine touches its {{token}} groups - the harness's unresolved-variable failure is never inherited), each block inside a fixed frame so the model cannot mistake it for harness state. Kinds (v1): time, counter, manifest, gauge, note, template; the substitution engine is token replace ONLY - no eval, no expressions (the programmable stage routes evaluation through the ptc-runtime later). Every knob is a volatile cell (hot edits commit without remounting): enabled, sectionName, refresh (request | ttl), ttlCalls, separator, sectionBudgetBytes and the block table. Counters (messages, turns, since last tool) come from the plugin's own agent/pre-step and tools/post-execute observers. The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture: it never appears in the profile's bundles and enables only by an explicit ACTIVATE; a cold mount logs disabled (enabled=false). Plan: Documentation/Plans/LIVE-CONTAINERS-RESEARCH.md (sections 3-5) + Documentation/Plans/LiveContainers/Design/IMPLEMENTATION-DESIGN.md (phase 1). Wave 2 extends the same plugin with the live tool-call transform (CAN-1: command calls detach into ctx.jobs background jobs, the model gets a [live] ... running marker as a SUCCESSFUL tool result, the producer re-dispatch preserves cwd/env/sandbox, the completion report arrives as a dynamic-context user-role snapshot batched per turn with a [live] next: resume hint), planted boards (CAN-2: live_plant + [live-report] pickup + the I5 parent-turn lease with the [stale] self-declaration), the CAN-4 failsafe engine (silent, ledger-first, the per-turn meta-budget), and the CAN-5 suggester (a detached one-shot subagent suggests a CONFIGURED block, accepted/dismissed with one-word live_container_set verbs; privacy redact by default). The plugin still ships DISABLED.
